title: Google Autocomplete - Keyword Suggestions & Seed Expansion
description: Minimal input: {"queries": ["keyword research"], "maxSuggestionsPerSeed": 3}. Each parsed source response costs $0.002 plus $0.0001 per delivered row. Empty/unchanged successful checks are billed. maxTotalChargeUsd belongs in Apify run options.

queries.title: Seed queries
queries.description: Seed queries, for example ["keyword research","coffee grinder"]. Up to 20. Each parsed query costs $0.002 plus $0.0001 per delivered unique suggestion. Suggestions do not include search volume or CPC.

maxSuggestionsPerSeed.title: Maximum suggestions per original seed
maxSuggestionsPerSeed.description: Total output ceiling per original seed across all its expanded queries combined. For example, 2 seeds with 50 each means at most 100 rows total ($0.01 in row fees), plus successful query-check fees. Applied after filters, exclusions and monitoring. Each delivered row costs $0.0001; source checks are separate. Fewer rows may exist. Duplicate results across sources are delivered only once.

country.title: Country hint
country.description: Lowercase two-letter country hint, for example "us", "gb" or "de". Default us. This is sent to Google; it does not prove the geographic origin of the suggestions. No extra locale fee.

language.title: Language hint
language.description: Language code, for example "en", "de", "ar" or "zh-CN". Default en. Suggestions may be multilingual. The output records this requested hint, not a detected language. No extra locale fee.

expandAlphabet.title: Expand seeds with a-z
expandAlphabet.description: false (DEFAULT) = one query per seed. true = seed plus seed a through seed z, up to 27 parsed queries per seed at $0.002 each, plus $0.0001 per delivered suggestion. Result and maxRequests limits can stop expansion early. Not recursive.

textContains.title: Text includes any phrase
textContains.description: Keep results containing any phrase, case-insensitive; for example ["office"] or ["free"]. Checks suggestion text. Empty [] accepts all. Applied before row charging; successful source checks still cost money.

textExcludes.title: Text excludes any phrase
textExcludes.description: Drop results containing any phrase, for example ["download"] or ["bedroom"]. Empty [] disables the filter. Filtered rows are not charged; successful source checks remain billable.

onlyNew.title: Only new results
onlyNew.description: false by default. true saves delivered IDs under monitorKey; later runs skip them. The first run returns the baseline. Successful checks still cost $0.002 each even with no new rows. Use an Apify schedule for recurring checks; this flag creates no schedule.

monitorKey.title: Monitor name
monitorKey.description: Name such as "daily-research"; default "default". Reuse it for repeat runs. Targets, date window, locale and filters automatically form a separate baseline when changed. Keeps the latest 50,000 IDs per scope. Do not overlap runs with the same name and scope.

excludeIds.title: Previously collected IDs
excludeIds.description: Optional output id values, for example ["previous-output-id"]. Up to 10,000. Empty [] excludes nothing. Useful for caller-managed deduplication. Excluded rows are not charged; parsed source checks are.

maxRequests.title: Maximum HTTP requests
maxRequests.description: Hard run-wide source request cap, for example 100; range 1–200. This is not a dollar limit. Set maxTotalChargeUsd as an Apify run option for a monetary cap.
